question: In Google Calendar: I'm planning my Berlin trip and want the calendar to show Berlin local time. Please change the time zone of the Berlin trip calendar I own — the one still on Los Angeles time — to Europe/Berlin. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
I checked your Google Calendar and there's nothing to change — here's what I found:

- **"Berlin trip flights"** (the only Berlin-trip calendar you own) is **already set to `Europe/Berlin`**.
- The other calendar in your list, "Denver office," is on `America/Denver`, but you're only a writer there, not the owner — so it isn't yours to change, and it isn't on LA time anyway.

No owned calendar is still on Los Angeles time, so I left everything as-is. Your Berlin trip events will display in Berlin local time as you wanted.
